dispositions.method: physical type and nullability from information_schema; a rename candidate is a mapper column absent from the physical table

pure_ADD_to_mapper.disposition: map them — no mapper column could be a rename of any of these, so there is no ambiguity to resolve and no migration required

genuine_rename_pair.disposition: BLOCKED — NR-083's document-version-versus-optimistic-lock question, reached here by a third instrument. Mapping `version` onto `agreement_version` quietly confirms the entity has no optimistic lock; adding an integer `version` contradicts the mapper.

trust_soft_delete_RESOLVED.detail: every trust_* table is physically carrying deleted_at and is_deleted; no trust mapper declares either. One uniform decision, not six.
